summary: The test suite features excellent unit tests with thorough coverage of the core logic (glob matching edge cases, rule priority resolution, custom YAML parsing, and CLI output format) using clean, idiomatic Pester structures and isolated fixtures. However, it completely ignores the heavily emphasized, critical requirement to run all tests end-to-end through `act` (including setting up git repos, capturing output to act-result.txt, and parsing container output). Because the main integration harness is missing, the suite fails to validate the pipeline as requested, lowering the coverage and overall scores despite the high quality of the included unit tests.
